summary: Layer 1B expansion found a two-lane universe around U.S. missile-production energetics and solid-rocket-motor inputs. Reference anchors are the two major solid-rocket-motor incumbents, while the underfollowed discovery lane centers on NewMarket's American Pacific ammonium-perchlorate exposure and Karman's SRM nozzle and energetics-adjacent production capacity. The highest-priority hidden mapping is not the missile prime but the sub-tier chemical/component capacity that can pace missile, interceptor, hypersonic, and strategic-deterrent output.
